title: Replace hero image with uploaded spices/herbs flat-lay photo

requirements.summary: Replace the current hero background image with the newly generated spices/herbs flat-lay photo while preserving all existing text overlays, gradient overlays, Ken Burns animation, and CTA buttons
acceptanceCriteria: The hero section displays the spices and herbs flat-lay photo (mortar and pestle, turmeric, ginger, garlic, rosemary, lemon) as its background image
All existing hero text, gradient overlays, Ken Burns zoom animation, and CTA buttons remain intact and functional
No other sections or components are altered
The image renders correctly on both desktop and mobile viewports

file_operations.description: Update the background image source to reference the newly generated static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg. Replace the existing backgroundImage URL in the component's styling/props while keeping all other hero functionality (text overlays, gradient overlays, Ken Burns animation, CTA buttons) completely unchanged. Ensure the image path is correct and the file is treated as a static asset accessible via /assets/generated/hero-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg at runtime.
